name: mdrv_update_file
description: Rename, move, star, or trash a file by `id`. Set `name` to rename. Set `folder_id` to move (a folder UUID, or null to move to the drive root) — include this field ONLY when moving. Set `starred` true/false to (un)star. Set `trashed` true to move to Trash, false to restore. Only the fields you send change. Requires the write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the updated file.

folder_id.description: New parent folder UUID, or null for the drive root. Include ONLY to move.
